item.title: On the field at Iolcus, Phaidias #5 the Twice-Born and Timeia #565 saw each other across t
item.description: On the field at Iolcus, Phaidias #5 the Twice-Born and Timeia #565 saw each other across the spears. Their houses are guest-friends. They lowered their weapons, as Glaukos and Diomedes did, and 269 were spared.
